checks.name: V1 [the stationary point L227 asked for is at the ORIGIN, not on the timelike branch] the derivative of a function with the deep-MOND branch is taken and its limit at the origin measured, since a vanishing slope there is what makes the cosmological state a stationary point
checks.reading: the slope vanishes at the origin for ANY function with a three-halves branch, so the cosmological state sits at a stationary point automatically. L227 V7 asked for one on the timelike branch; it is at the boundary between the branches instead, which is easier to satisfy and is CORRECTED here

checks.name: V2 [and that point is the function's non-analytic point] the second derivative is taken and its behaviour at the origin measured, since a divergence there is what makes the point special rather than merely stationary
checks.reading: the curvature diverges. The cosmological state is the NON-ANALYTIC point of the scalar's kinetic function, and MOND is the critical behaviour around it with exponent three halves. That is a physical picture, and it is what the principle below formalises

checks.name: V3 [the scalar renormalises Newton's constant, and by how much] the high-acceleration scalar force is formed as a fraction of the Newtonian one and the observed Newton constant read off, since every later step must use the OBSERVED one
checks.reading: the ratio is twice the coupling strength over the function's high-acceleration value. This factor is invisible in the deep-MOND limit and is exactly what a careless derivation drops

checks.name: V4 [the acceleration scale, as an output] the deep-MOND spherical solution is solved, the acceleration on matter formed, matched to the MOND form using the OBSERVED Newton constant, and the dependence on the enclosed mass measured
checks.reading: mass-independent, so it is a constant of the theory. And it carries mu squared, which is the dark-energy scale, because the function has no scale of its own -- that is the principle doing its work

checks.name: V5 [and kappa is a pure number, with the scale gone] the ratio defining kappa is formed with the vacuum energy equal to the single scale to the fourth, and its dependence on that scale measured
checks.reading: the scale cancels exactly. kappa is now a function of the coupling strength and two numbers read off the fixed shape, and of nothing else

checks.name: V6 [the factor is worth an order, which is why the naive version cannot be trusted] kappa is evaluated at a reference shape with and without the Newton-constant renormalisation, and the ratio measured against 2
checks.measured: with renormalisation 1.25331; without 3.54491; ratio 2.8284 = 2^{3/2} at this point
checks.reading: a factor of two and a half at the equipartition point, and larger elsewhere. A derivation that drops it lands on a different normalisation by that much, which is more than enough to manufacture or destroy an exact hit. This is why the naive version of this calculation is not reported as a result

checks.name: V7 [the principle reduces two free numbers to ONE, and that one is measurable] the shape normalisation required to give kappa = 1/2 is solved for across the allowed range of the Newton-constant renormalisation, and the spread measured
checks.measured: the required normalisation spans 0.067 to 283.908 as G_obs/G_b runs from 1.043 to 3.000
checks.reading: once the shape is fixed, everything rides on how much the scalar renormalises Newton's constant at high acceleration. That is not a free parameter of taste -- it is a physical quantity that primordial nucleosynthesis and the microwave background constrain, and this programme has bounded a G shift at the four-percent level before

checks.name: V8 [so: is 6.6843 derived? NO, and here is exactly what is missing] the status of the target number after this lane is stated against what a derivation would require
checks.measured: the principle removes a_0 as an independent scale, makes a_0 proportional to the root of the vacuum energy automatic, ties the branch coefficient to the shape normalisation as b = K/3, and leaves ONE number: the ratio xi/K, equivalently the high-acceleration renormalisation of Newton's constant. 6.6843 follows only once that is fixed
checks.reading: this is a reduction from two unknowns to one, with the survivor being a physical and in-principle measurable quantity rather than a free coefficient. It is NOT a derivation of 6.6843, and this lane does not claim one
